highlights: close to town centre and local amenities
summary: This four-bedroom period terraced townhouse is located in the highly sought-after West End of town, offering charm and character in a prime location.
description:
The property boasts high ceilings and original character features, enhancing its timeless appeal. This elegant four-bedroom period townhouse is ideally situated within close proximity to the main town centre, offering easy access to a variety of shops, amenities, and services. Its location is also highly convenient for families, being near local schools and a sixth form college, ensuring excellent educational options are within walking distance. This prime location enhances the property's appeal for those seeking both character and convenience. The ground floor comprises of a welcoming hallway. Two reception rooms, offering versatile living spaces, The lounge features a beautiful wooden feature fire surround, creating a warm and inviting focal point perfect for relaxing evenings. The dining room benefits from patio doors that open directly onto the rear garden, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living, ideal for entertaining or enjoying meals with a view. The property includes a fitted kitchen, designed for practicality and efficiency, with ample workspace and storage. It also features a convenient rear porch with door access to the rear garden, providing easy access for outdoor dining, gardening, or bringing in fresh air and natural light. The first floor provides three bedrooms, each with ample space and natural light, a family bathroom and a separate WC, adding convenience for family living whilst a spacious fourth bedroom, perfect for a master suite, guest room, or additional living space. The front garden is set back from the road, providing privacy and curb appeal and the good size rear garden which is an additional advantage for a period terraced house, offering excellent space for outdoor activities, gardening, or entertaining. This family home is offered with no onward chain and the property combines the elegance of period architecture with practical living spaces, making it an ideal choice for families or buyers looking for a home full of character in a prestigious location.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY The property features a welcoming hallway with stairs access, creating an inviting first impression. This well-lit and functional space provides easy access to the main living areas and the upper floor, setting the tone for the home's thoughtful layout.

LOUNGE The lounge is a standout feature of the property, showcasing high ceilings that enhance the sense of space and elegance. A large bay window floods the room with natural light while adding character and charm. The centrepiece of the lounge is a beautiful feature fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxation or entertaining.

DINING ROOM The dining room is a delightful space, continuing the theme of high ceilings that add an airy and elegant feel. A charming feature fireplace serves as a focal point, enhancing the room's warmth and character. Patio doors open directly into the rear garden, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor spaces and making the room ideal for both dining and entertaining.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of fitted white base and wall units, offering ample storage, laminate work surfaces, inset sink unit with drainer. The layout is designed for practicality, providing plenty of workspace for meal preparation. A door leads directly to the rear garden, adding convenience and creating an easy flow between indoor and outdoor spaces.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

With built in storage cupboard, stairs access to the second floor.

BEDROOM ONE The double bedroom is a bright and inviting space, featuring a charming bay window that enhances the room's natural light and adds a touch of elegance. With ample space for a double bed and additional furniture, this bedroom combines comfort and style, making it a peaceful retreat within the home.

BEDROOM TWO The bedroom features a window that overlooks the garden, offering a peaceful and scenic view. This addition fills the room with natural light, creating a calming atmosphere. It provides a sense of tranquillity, making the space ideal for relaxation and rest.

BEDROOM THREE

The bedroom features a window to the frontage, allowing natural light to brighten the room and offering views of the front of the property. This window enhances the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while adding to the overall appeal of the room.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom features a fitted white suite, including a panel bath with a shower over for both convenience and relaxation. A wash hand basin is neatly integrated, and a radiator adds warmth to the space. The simple yet functional design creates a clean, fresh atmosphere, ideal for everyday use.

SECOND FLOOR

BEDROOM FOUR

The attic bedroom offers a unique and cosy space, featuring a window that fills the room with natural light and provides a pleasant view. This room also includes a fitted wash hand basin, adding convenience and functionality to the space. Ideal for a private retreat, it combines comfort with practical features in a charming, elevated setting.

EXTERNALLY To the frontage there is an enclosed garden area with gated access with a variety of trees and shrubbery, whilst to the rear there is an enclosed rear garden features a well-maintained lawn, providing a lush and green area perfect for relaxation or play. Paved seating areas are strategically placed throughout the garden, offering ideal spots for outdoor dining or enjoying the surroundings. A variety of trees and shrubs are thoughtfully arranged, adding texture and seasonal interest to the landscape, with some providing shade and privacy. This garden space creates a peaceful, natural retreat ideal for unwinding and entertaining.
